description: Taxonomy: topics, fields, checklist, findings and the other enums. Document types are in doc_types.json; the model checks that tag a document with a topic are in document_tags.json, keyed by topic id. All ids are stable machine keys; labels and descriptions are display text for people (the model never sees them).

topics.label: Income
topics.description: Money a person earned or received: wages and salary, bonuses, interest, dividends, business income and benefits such as Social Security

topics.label: Retirement
topics.description: Retirement accounts and plans: 401(k), 403(b), IRA and pension contributions, plan coverage, distributions and rollovers

topics.label: Tax
topics.description: Tax returns and tax reporting: income tax withheld or owed, IRS information returns and amounts used to file

topics.label: Self-employment
topics.description: Income from working for oneself: freelance and contractor pay (1099-NEC), Schedule C business income and business ownership

topics.label: Health savings
topics.description: Health savings accounts: HSA contributions and balances, and the HSA-eligible high deductible health plans that allow them

topics.label: Cash and banking
topics.description: Cash held at a bank: checking and savings balances, deposits, withdrawals and interest earned on cash

topics.label: Investments
topics.description: Taxable investing: brokerage accounts, securities and their market value, dividends and capital gains

topics.label: Home and mortgage
topics.description: The home and what it costs: mortgages and home loans, mortgage interest, property taxes and home purchases

topics.label: Insurance
topics.description: Insurance coverage and premiums: health, life, disability, long-term care and property insurance

topics.label: Estate
topics.description: Estate planning: wills, trusts, guardianship and beneficiary designations

topics.label: Education
topics.description: Paying for education: 529 plans and other education savings, tuition and student loans for school

topics.label: Life event
topics.description: A change in the household: a birth or new dependent, marriage or divorce, a new home, a new job or a large change in income

topics.label: Equity compensation
topics.description: Pay in company stock: restricted stock units (RSUs), stock options and employee stock purchase plans (ESPP)

topics.label: Debt
topics.description: Money owed other than a mortgage: credit cards, student loans, auto loans and personal loans

topics.label: Charitable giving
topics.description: Gifts to charity: donation receipts, donor-advised funds and charitable contributions for taxes

topics.label: Social Security and Medicare
topics.description: Government retirement and health benefits: Social Security benefit statements (SSA-1099) and Medicare coverage or premiums
